mapper.select: SELECT award_id as awardId, student_id as studentId, competition_name as competitionName, award_grade as awardGrade, award_time as awardTime, achievement_desc as achievementDesc, create_time as createTime FROM competition_award WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM competition_award WHERE award_id = #{awardId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
